comment: Paintings already considered and turned down, so the same candidate is not sourced, resized and measured a second time. Checked before anything else in the add-painting skill, and appended to on every rejection. Reasons: nudity | no-quiet-paint | too-smooth | nothing-busy | cannot-hold-a-week | not-public-domain | duplicate-painter | other.

rejected.title: The Garden of Earthly Delights
rejected.note: Also fails the rate: quietest 29.9 against 18.5 for every painting that has tuned cleanly, so its Monday could not be made easy at any fill or opacity. Either reason alone is disqualifying.

rejected.title: The Fighting Temeraire
rejected.note: Median texture 8.2 -- nothing anywhere for a shape to hide in, so hard-to-scan and visible-once-framed became mutually exclusive. All seven days had to be raised to stay visible and none could be made hard. Caught only after the ramp started aiming at times.
